info.name: Internship Backend — social network
info.description:
Users, posts, comments, likes and groups, over REST and GraphQL.

Send **Auth > Login** first: its test script stores `token` and `refreshToken` as collection variables and every other request picks them up automatically.

variable.description: Where the backend is listening. Point it somewhere else to run the same requests against another instance.
Access token. Filled in by Auth > Login.
Refresh token. Filled in by Auth > Login.

request.description:
Exchanges credentials for an access/refresh pair. The test script stores both in collection variables, so every other request below is authenticated - run this first.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

Trades the refresh token for a new pair, consuming the old one. Rotation is enforced: replaying a spent token revokes the whole session family.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

Creates an account that can log in immediately. Emails are unique case-insensitively - edit the address before re-sending, or the second call is a 409.

Callable without a token. Expected: 201.

currentPassword is always required. Changing the password revokes every other session and returns a fresh token pair; changing only the email returns none.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 200.

Revokes the refresh token in the database and blacklists the access token in memory. Unguarded on purpose: it must work with an expired token.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

A page: { items, total, limit, offset }. Each row carries likesCount, commentsCount and its own author’s authorPhoto - but not the likers.

Callable without a token. Expected: 200.

The author is taken from the token, not the body.

Requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Expected: 201.

graphql.query:
query AllPosts($limit: Int, $offset: Int) {
  allPosts(limit: $limit, offset: $offset) {
    id
    authorId
    author {
      id
      username
      email
      firstName
      secondName
      description
      profileImage
      creationDate
      modifiedDate
    }
    title
    content
    image
    creationDate
    modifiedDate
    likesCount
    commentsCount
    likedByUsers {
      id
      username
      email
      firstName
      secondName
      description
      profileImage
      creationDate
      modifiedDate
    }
  }
}
